data.body:
**Status — kept OPEN; clean apply/close deferred to operator-supervised window.**

The code fix (`13e2ea6d`) remains merged and AC1 (`terraform plan` exits 0) satisfied. The two live-validation ACs still require a `terraform apply`, which cannot be run autonomously: a clean apply here now shares the SAME physical apply as the `value_wo` migration on `origin/main:ssm.tf`, which would overwrite all 21 prod SecureString secrets with the `CHANGEME` placeholder (write-only arg, invisible in the plan diff) → prod auth/signing/reconcile outage. The 3 `mcp-client-pat` `ParameterAlreadyExists` collisions from the earlier partial apply are fixed by change 2389 (import blocks, pending Submit).

Deferred to an operator-supervised maintenance window that runs the value_wo cutover + in-window re-seed of all real secret values (tracked on `097b-de23-bf12-4c38`; secrets classification + rotation deferral recorded there — nothing was rotated, no AWS mutation performed). Follow-up `polonium-deceptive-antelope` (f268-32ae-4ea9-42fb) already tracks the apply decision. Remaining OPEN until that supervised apply completes.
